Product:

Main Asset:
MP / R2 170001564
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
The charger is currently showing the Siemens router as offline. Please check the following:
- Ensure the SIM card is properly inserted.
-Verify that the network is stable.

I will send you all the necessary references for the specific Router required for this charger

eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue

unified service process

additional_info.subject: Answer to Bart
additional_info.body:
We have on the following charger MP/R2170001564 already had several times the case that we have the following screen:
undefined
image.png
After reboot Ok !
Did you see this behavior before on other Siemens Sicharge D Chargers?
Can it be that the data on the PLC is corrupt ?
I don’t know if it is possible to load again the logic onto the Plc by remote ?
From the picture the charger is stuck in the grub selection. Didn't found a boot device. Or the boot selection was wrong or by some mistake couldn't boot from cfast card. In this case is not possible to perform any action remotely because the charger is off, the image didn't boot yet in this stage.
If this is a permanent issue or reoccurring many times, the cfast card must be replaced.
